notes.title: Installation and Startup Problems(Jun 4th)
notes.content:
Hi,

Some antivirus programs recognize Princess Maker 5 program as a virus, 
preventing its normal installation and program to start up.

We have now solved the problems with major antivirus tools as below. 

- V3
- Alyac
- BITDEFENDER 
- F-secure 
- Microsoft security essentials
- Malwarebytes

<Requesting Action At This Time>
- Avast free Antivirus

Please let us know the information on your antivirus tool if you still have similar problems, 
and we will take action accordingly.

Thank you.
